text:
rachel: FYI I ran a canary for ranky-mini-v1 -> int4-adaptive overnight. Overall NDCG@10 stable but MRR down ~2.6% on prod-holdout. Feels like top-1 flips. Anyone free to eyeball?

tom: is that vs fp16 or int8 baseline? cohort breakdown?

rachel: vs fp16. int8 was +0.1%. Biggest regression on queries with lots of near-duplicates and when candidate pool contains many short titles (<=6 tokens). NDCG@1 -4.8%.

priya: duplicates + short titles = classic quant tie problem. Did calibration use domain samples? Also check dedupe strategy parity between bench and prod: bench canonicalizes titles differently.

rachel: bench applied title canonicalization (strip punctuation, collapse whitespace). Prod doesn't. I re-ran a small fixed-order job with prod-preproc and gap increased slightly.

niko: Could be collision in embedding normalization before rerank (we use raw logits then scale). Quant might change scale; try post-quant learned rescale or temperature tweak. Also check per-channel vs per-tensor quant.

ci-bot: CI: job 4187659999-1 queued by rachel  tag=ranky-mini-v1-int4-adaptive, dataset=prod-holdout/fix-order, ETA ~15m

rachel: queued three quick jobs: fp16 baseline, int8, int4-adaptive (default per-tensor calset=generic). Will also collect 10 failure pairs.

ci-bot: CI: job 4187659999-1 finished  fp16 baseline NDCG@10=0.391, MRR=0.544
ci-bot: CI: job 4187659999-2 finished  int8 NDCG@10=0.390, MRR=0.545
ci-bot: CI: job 4187659999-3 finished  int4-adaptive NDCG@10=0.389, MRR=0.530 (-2.6% MRR)

priya: gap localized to MRR suggests top1 flips. Try calibrating with a short-title focused calset (title-short-3k) and per-channel scaling. Also test no-kvcache + fixed-order since nondet cache warmups can hide issues.

tom: also check candidate id normalization: earlier we had bench normalize unicode and remove diacritics, prod keeps them. That can change tokenization & BPE.

rachel: good catch. I found a mismatch: bench lowercased titles before tokenization. I re-ran int4 job with prod-preproc (no lowercasing), per-channel quant, calset=title-short-3k and post-rescale=0.99. Command: 

```
rerank-eval --model ranky-mini-v1 --quant int4-perchannel --calset title-short-3k \
  --dataset prod-holdout --preproc prod-parity --fix-order --no-prefix-cache \
  --post-rescale 0.99
```

ci-bot: CI: job 4187659999-4 queued  int4-perchannel-titlecal+rescale0.99 ETA ~20m

priya: if that recovers, propose we add a "title-short" slice to quant holdout and require preproc parity tests in the onboarding checklist.

ci-bot: CI: job 4187659999-4 finished  int4-perchannel-titlecal+rescale0.99 NDCG@10=0.390, MRR=0.541 (recovery to -0.7% MRR)

rachel: much better. I'll open a PR with three changes: 1) default int4 flow uses per-channel for rerankers, 2) add title-short calset to PTQ calset list, 3) bench holdout to enforce preproc parity and fixed ordering for dedupe-sensitive datasets.

tom: :thumbsup: also add a note to model-card: int4 caveats for short-title-heavy pools and the temporary routing rule (route short-title queries to int8 if regression exceeds 1% MRR).

priya: can you paste the 10 failure pairs before you close the canary? I'll add to the eval playbook.

rachel: will paste them and the brief blurb. Thanks all!
